name: engram
description: Persistent shared memory for Codex. Requires ENGRAM_URL and ENGRAM_TOKEN from a dashboard-issued worker keycard; the server operator key must stay on the server host.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent shared memory for Codex workspaces
interface.longDescription: Engram connects Codex to a shared PostgreSQL-backed memory service. Configure ENGRAM_URL and ENGRAM_TOKEN with a worker keycard issued from the Engram dashboard /tokens page; never use the server operator key on a workstation.
defaultPrompt: Configure Engram for Codex by asking for the server URL and dashboard-issued worker keycard, then write ENGRAM_URL and ENGRAM_TOKEN to ~/.codex/config.toml under shell_environment_policy.set.
Run Engram Doctor to verify the MCP connection and report the server version.
